key_insight: A pretrained text-to-image Diffusion Transformer can be repurposed as a strong reward model by scoring near-clean image latents with text-conditioned representations, not just by generating images.
engineering_relevance: This suggests generative backbones can be reused for preference modeling and policy optimization, enabling better alignment and faster inference than separate reward networks.
method: Convert a pretrained text-to-image DiT into a reward model using near-clean image latents.
Aggregate text-conditioned image features across transformer layers with a lightweight learned head.
Probe depth and scale, then apply the reward model in Flow-GRPO optimization of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large.
evidence_signal: With the same training data mixture as HPSv3, DiT-Reward outperforms it on all four preference benchmarks, reaching 85.6% on HPDv2 and 77.6% on HPDv3, and also achieves a 1.65x inference speedup in direct latent scoring.
watch_item: Performance depends on access to a strong pretrained generative DiT and near-clean latent inputs, so transfer quality and deployment efficiency may drop if the backbone or latent quality differs from the studied setting.
paper_title: DiT-Reward: Generative Representations for Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
